## Database Architecture  
### Primary Database (PostgreSQL)  
**Database:** `firstuk_prod`  
**Schemas:**
- `public.accounts` — Account records (800 records)
- `public.customers` — Customer records (500 records)
- `public.transactions` — Transaction log (2,000+ records/month)
- `public.account_holders` — Joint account holders
- `public.standing_orders` — Recurring transfers
- `public.direct_debits` — Recurring bill payments
- `public.cards` — Debit card records (800 cards)
- `public.compliance_kyc` — KYC verification records
- `public.compliance_aml` — AML screening records
- `public.products` — Product definitions (5 products)  
**Indexes:**
- Customer ID (for lookups)
- Account ID (for queries)
- Transaction date (for history)
- Account status (for reporting)  
**Backup Strategy:**
- Continuous replication to standby database
- Daily encrypted backup to AWS S3
- RPO: 15 minutes
- RTO: 2 hours

raw_entities.name: FirstUK Production Database
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL production database hosting core banking data including accounts, customers, transactions, and compliance records. Supports 800+ account records, 500+ customer records, and 2,000+ monthly transactions with continuous replication and daily encrypted backup to AWS S3.
context: Daily encrypted backup to AWS S3

raw_entities.name: Account Records Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing account records within the FirstUK production database. Contains 800 account records indexed by Account ID for efficient query performance.

raw_entities.name: Customer Records Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing customer records within the FirstUK production database. Contains 500 customer records indexed by Customer ID for efficient lookups.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Log Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing transaction records within the FirstUK production database. Maintains 2,000+ transaction records per month indexed by transaction date for historical analysis and reporting.

raw_entities.name: Account Holders Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing joint account holder records within the FirstUK production database, capturing relationships between multiple account holders and their accounts.

raw_entities.name: Standing Orders Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing standing order payment instructions within the FirstUK production database, capturing recurring transfer configurations.

raw_entities.name: Direct Debits Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing direct debit mandate records within the FirstUK production database, capturing recurring bill payment configurations.

raw_entities.name: Cards Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing debit card records within the FirstUK production database. Contains 800 card records linked to customer accounts.

raw_entities.name: Compliance KYC Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing Know Your Customer verification records within the FirstUK production database, capturing identity and address verification data.

raw_entities.name: Compliance AML Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing Anti-Money Laundering screening records within the FirstUK production database, capturing sanctions and PEP list check results.

raw_entities.name: Products Schema
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL schema storing product definitions within the FirstUK production database. Contains 5 product definitions available to customers.

raw_entities.name: AWS S3 Backup Storage
raw_entities.description: Cloud storage service used for encrypted daily backups of the FirstUK production database, providing off-site disaster recovery capability.
context: Daily encrypted backup to AWS S3

raw_entities.name: Standby Database
raw_entities.description: PostgreSQL standby database receiving continuous replication from the primary FirstUK production database, supporting high availability and disaster recovery objectives.

raw_entities.name: Recovery Point Objective
raw_entities.description: Service level agreement defining the maximum acceptable data loss in the event of a database failure. Set to 15 minutes for the FirstUK production environment.

raw_entities.name: Recovery Time Objective
raw_entities.description: Service level agreement defining the maximum acceptable downtime for database recovery. Set to 2 hours for the FirstUK production environment.

raw_entities.name: Account Records Capacity
raw_entities.description: Current capacity metric for the accounts schema within the FirstUK production database.

raw_entities.name: Customer Records Capacity
raw_entities.description: Current capacity metric for the customers schema within the FirstUK production database.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Processing Rate
raw_entities.description: Monthly transaction volume processed through the FirstUK production database transaction log.

raw_entities.name: Debit Card Issuance Capacity
raw_entities.description: Current capacity metric for debit cards issued and tracked within the FirstUK production database.

raw_entities.name: Product Portfolio Size
raw_entities.description: Number of distinct banking products defined and available within the FirstUK product catalog.
